summary: Environment A direct-binary verification for the Phase 9 Windows rebuild (Bible Translation Registry v2 - licensing metadata & enforcement) - this phase adds a new migration and new Rust orchestration code compiled into the desktop binary, so a genuine rebuild with direct binary proof is required.
buildResult: Rust build succeeded (whisper-rs-sys ggml lib-name two-pass fix applied as expected on the first-attempt failure, unrelated to this phase's own changes); pnpm build (tsc -b && vite build) succeeded producing a fresh dist/assets bundle; NSIS packaging finished with the three runtime DLLs confirmed present by the script's own built-in check.

installer.fileSizeDeltaNote: A real but modest increase, consistent with a schema-and-orchestration phase rather than a new dependency phase: one new migration (14 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN statements, compiled in as a literal SQL string via include_str!), a new UsagePermissions type with 8 small helper methods, and one new pure gate function (ensure_ai_processing_permitted) plus its call-site changes in two existing commands. No new crate dependencies were added this phase - the installer's SHA-256 changing, plus the literal SQL column-name strings and symbol counts below, are the decisive proof this rebuild reflects this phase's real code.

extractionMethod: 7z x against the built installer into a scratch directory; confirmed exit code 0 and listed contents.

symbolRegressionCheck.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings/nm against the extracted cip-desktop.exe, re-run for every prior-phase symbol/string this project has established as a regression tripwire.

whisper_full_with_state.note: Stable at 96 for a third consecutive rebuild since the Phase 7.3 investigation confirmed this is the same non-deterministic strings/grep line-coalescing artifact previously stabilized at 93 for nine rebuilds (Phase 6.2-7.2) - no file in ai/speech, integrations/audio, or any whisper-rs-touching path changed this phase either.

phase8ProductionIntegrationSymbols.note: Confirms Phase 8's Production Integration code is still compiled in and unregressed by this phase's changes.

symbolRegressionCheck.conclusion: Every prior-phase Rust-side symbol/string count is exactly unchanged from the Phase 8 baseline. Zero regression in any pre-existing feature.

newSymbolsThisPhase.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-nm -C and strings against the extracted cip-desktop.exe, searching for this phase's own new function names and, since ensure_ai_processing_permitted/UsagePermissions::permits_ai_processing are small single-call-site functions the release optimizer inlines away (0 nm hits, an expected and previously-unremarkable Rust-inlining outcome, not evidence of absence), for the literal SQL column-name strings migration 0016 embeds via include_str! - direct proof the real Phase 9 code actually compiled into this exact binary.

inlinedNotAbsent.ensure_ai_processing_permitted: 0 nm hits - inlined into generate_verse_embeddings's call site in the release build, matching how small single-caller functions are routinely optimized away; the migration-string and generate_verse_embeddings/UsagePermissions evidence below establishes the real code path is present.
inlinedNotAbsent.permits_ai_processing: 0 nm hits - same inlining explanation; UsagePermissions itself (the type these methods are defined on) is present 9 times.

newSymbolsThisPhase.conclusion: Direct nm evidence for the command-level symbols this phase changed, plus direct strings evidence (the literal SQL migration text, which can only be present if migration 0016 is compiled into this binary via include_str!) for the schema/type layer whose small helper methods were inlined away - together, direct proof this phase's implementation is compiled into this exact packaged .exe.

frontendTextSearch.conclusion: Reproduces the established Tauri-frontend-bundle tooling limitation (documented since Phase 6.1) a twelfth time - the control string itself returns 0 matches, so this says nothing about correctness either way. This phase made no frontend UI copy changes (only type/interface changes to domain/content.ts), so no new-string check applies here; correctness for the frontend surface rests on npm run typecheck's success, the fresh Vite build producing a new asset bundle hash, and the full 266/266 frontend test pass.

architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands, zero new events - generate_verse_embeddings and get_embedding_capabilities are the only two existing command bodies changed.
core/bible and core/service (Bible detection) have zero symbol-level changes.

Every prior-phase symbol tracked above (including all of Phase 8's Production Integration symbols) is present and unchanged - confirmed by direct nm/strings lookup, not just absence of a regression flag.
Migration 0016 is purely additive (14 nullable ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN statements) - confirmed via the literal SQL strings above; no existing content_registry row's data changes shape.
environmentCStatus: NOT YET VERIFIED for this exact artifact - the decisive pending gate is the operator's own real-hardware test: with a real installed CIP and BSB loaded, click 'Generate verse embeddings' (or the equivalent Diagnostics Mode action) and confirm it still succeeds now that the ai_processing_allowed gate is wired in, since BSB's dataset asset records that permission as true.
